name: Carr Davis Jennings
bio: As the founder of Box Out for Hunger, I am passionate about using basketball to fight food insecurity and give back to my community. My goal is to bring people together to support families in need and make a lasting impact through service.
imageAlt: Carr at a Box Out For Hunger service event

name: Jeremiah Adeyanju
bio: I am passionate about Box Out for Hunger because I believe no one should have to worry about where their next meal will come from. I've always wanted to make a positive impact in my community, and I believe that even the smallest acts of kindness can make a big difference. Through donating to local food pantries, I hope to help families in need, inspire others to give back, and show that a little kindness can go a long way.

name: Charles Eyster
bio: I am a high school student passionate about serving others, making a positive impact in my community, and using my skills to help those in need. Through Box Out for Hunger, I hope to make a lasting difference and inspire others to give back.
imageAlt: Charles at a Box Out For Hunger service event
